name: Additive Metaball Modification for Marching Cubes
definition: A technique to allow dynamic modification of a Marching Cubes terrain (digging/placing blocks) by adding user-defined density functions (metaballs) to the base noise function, allowing smooth integration of changes without altering the underlying pseudo-random sequence.
summary: Additive Metaball Modification for Marching Cubes enables dynamic terrain editing by superimposing user-defined density functions onto a base noise field, avoiding global artifacts caused by direct grid alteration.
